hooks.text: 突刺或劈砍、单手或双手等4种风格与6类变化组合出数百套武器方案
hooks.excerpt: Thrusting or slashing, one-handed or two-handed, choose from four styles and six variations with hundreds of possible combinations – exploit the full potential of your weapons.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 战斗材料既可在铁匠处强化装备，也可献给神像换取额外神恩
hooks.excerpt: Use the resources you obtain during your fights to bolster your weapons, improve your equipment at the blacksmith's, and make offerings to the divine statue to garner additional favors.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 解锁90种以上神圣祝福，并同步定制天赋、技能和装备形成长期构筑
hooks.excerpt: Pledge your allegiance, unlock over 90 divine blessing powers, customize your talents and skills, and upgrade your equipment in a gameplay experience packed with replayability!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 美术风格获得满分评价。
角色设计获得满分评价。
游戏很快变得重复乏味
内容量不足，只有三个关卡。

excerpts.excerpt: There is just not enough content here. There is 3 levels.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 肉鸽元素不足以改变每局打法。

excerpts.excerpt: the rogue like elements, while interesting in a vacuum, don't do enough to spice up each run
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 高难度的速度要求会大幅压缩可行选择

excerpts.excerpt: At high ascension (/heat), the game requires speed, so the choice is dramatically reduced
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 攻击判定和闪避帧不可靠。

excerpts.excerpt: The hit detection and dodge frames in this game are absolute garbage and don't make sense at all.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 武器和饰品效果对构筑有明显影响。

excerpts.excerpt: the effects of each weapon and each trinket have a noticeable impact
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 核心战斗打磨充分且质量很高。

excerpts.excerpt: The core combat is so polished and high quality
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 战斗节奏较慢但仍有趣且令人满意。

excerpts.excerpt: its combat is slower but still very interesting and satisfying
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
